result.topic_en: Formula-only calculations on the equations of motion of an elastic medium (aether): the curl and divergence of the displacement field, a wave equation with Laplacian and divergence terms, and the corresponding energy-type integrals obtained by multiplying by the acceleration and integrating by parts.
result.transcription:
$\int \left(\frac{\partial u_1}{\partial x_2}-\frac{\partial u_2}{\partial x_1}\right)^2+\left(\frac{\partial u_2}{\partial x_3}-\frac{\partial u_3}{\partial x_2}\right)^2+\left(\quad\right)^2 dx_1\,dx_2\,dx_3$ =
$\frac{\partial u_1}{\partial x_1}+\frac{\partial u_2}{\partial x_2}+\frac{\partial u_3}{\partial x_3}=0$
$\left(\frac{\partial^2 u_1}{\partial t^2}-\alpha\alpha\left(\frac{\partial^2 u_1}{\partial x_1^2}+\frac{\partial^2 u_1}{\partial x_2^2}+\frac{\partial^2 u_1}{\partial x_3^2}\right)\right)-\beta\beta\frac{\partial}{\partial x_1}\left(\frac{\partial u_1}{\partial x_1}\cdots\right)=0$
$\delta\frac{\partial^2 u_1}{\partial t^2}$
$\frac{\partial^2 u_1}{\partial t^2}-\alpha\alpha\Delta_1\Delta u$ [-$+\alpha\alpha$-] $+\beta\beta)\frac{\partial}{\partial x_1}\left(\quad\right)=0$
$\int\delta\frac{\partial^2 u_1}{\partial t^2}\left(\quad\right)dx_1\,dx_2\,dx_3=\Sigma\int\frac{\partial^2 u_1}{\partial t^2}\delta\frac{\partial^2 u_1}{\partial t^2}+\alpha\alpha\frac{\partial u_1}{\partial x_1}\delta\frac{\partial^3 u_1}{\partial x_1\partial t^2}$
$\frac{\partial(\Delta_1 u)}{\partial x_2}-\frac{\partial(\Delta_2 u)}{\partial x_1}$
$\int\left(\frac{\partial u_1}{\partial x_1}+\frac{\partial u_2}{\partial x_2}+\frac{\partial u_3}{\partial x_3}\right)^2 dx_1dx_2dx_3$
$\int\frac{1}{2}\left(\frac{\partial^2 u_1}{\partial t^2}\right)^2-\alpha\alpha\frac{\partial^2 u_1}{\partial t^2}\left(\frac{\partial^2 u_1}{\partial x_1^2}+\frac{\partial^2 u_1}{\partial x_2^2}\right)dx_1dx_2dx_3=$
$\Sigma\int\frac{1}{2}\left(\frac{\partial^2 u_1}{\partial t^2}\right)^2+\alpha\alpha\left(\frac{\partial u_1}{\partial x_1}\frac{\partial^3 u_1}{\partial x_1\partial t^2}\right)dx_1dx_2dx_3$
[?]$\left(\frac{\partial u_1}{\partial x_1}\right)^2$ $+\beta\beta\int\left(\frac{\partial u_1}{\partial x_1}+\frac{\partial u_2}{\partial x_2}+\frac{\partial u_3}{\partial x_3}\right)^2 dx_1dx_2dx_3=0$
[-$\beta\beta$-] $\frac{\partial^2 u_1}{\partial t^2}\left(\frac{\partial}{\partial x_1}\left(\frac{\partial u_1}{\partial x_1}+\frac{\partial u_2}{\partial x_2}+\frac{\partial u_3}{\partial x_3}\right)\right)$
[-...-]$\left(\frac{\partial u_1}{\partial x_1}+\frac{\partial u_2}{\partial x_2}+\frac{\partial u_3}{\partial x_3}\right)$
$\alpha\alpha\Sigma\left(\frac{\partial u_1}{\partial x_2}-\frac{\partial u_2}{\partial x_1}\right)^2$
$\Delta(u)$ $-2\frac{\partial u_1}{\partial x_2}\frac{\partial u_2}{\partial x_1}+2\frac{\partial u_1}{\partial x_1}\frac{\partial u_2}{\partial x_2}$

methods.what: Integral of the squared curl components of the displacement field
methods.quote: $\int \left(\frac{\partial u_1}{\partial x_2}-\frac{\partial u_2}{\partial x_1}\right)^2+\left(\frac{\partial u_2}{\partial x_3}-\frac{\partial u_3}{\partial x_2}\right)^2+\left(\quad\right)^2 dx_1\,dx_2\,dx_3$
$\frac{\partial u_1}{\partial x_1}+\frac{\partial u_2}{\partial x_2}+\frac{\partial u_3}{\partial x_3}=0$

methods.what: Elastic wave equation (Navier-type) with Laplacian term and gradient-of-divergence term
methods.quote: $\left(\frac{\partial^2 u_1}{\partial t^2}-\alpha\alpha\left(\frac{\partial^2 u_1}{\partial x_1^2}+\frac{\partial^2 u_1}{\partial x_2^2}+\frac{\partial^2 u_1}{\partial x_3^2}\right)\right)-\beta\beta\frac{\partial}{\partial x_1}\left(\frac{\partial u_1}{\partial x_1}\cdots\right)=0$

methods.what: Variational/energy integral obtained by multiplying the equation by the varied acceleration and integrating by parts
methods.quote: $\int\delta\frac{\partial^2 u_1}{\partial t^2}\left(\quad\right)dx_1\,dx_2\,dx_3=\Sigma\int\frac{\partial^2 u_1}{\partial t^2}\delta\frac{\partial^2 u_1}{\partial t^2}+\alpha\alpha\frac{\partial u_1}{\partial x_1}\delta\frac{\partial^3 u_1}{\partial x_1\partial t^2}$

methods.what: Integration by parts of the Laplacian term in the energy integral
methods.quote: $\Sigma\int\frac{1}{2}\left(\frac{\partial^2 u_1}{\partial t^2}\right)^2+\alpha\alpha\left(\frac{\partial u_1}{\partial x_1}\frac{\partial^3 u_1}{\partial x_1\partial t^2}\right)dx_1dx_2dx_3$

methods.what: Integral of squared divergence as energy term
methods.quote: $+\beta\beta\int\left(\frac{\partial u_1}{\partial x_1}+\frac{\partial u_2}{\partial x_2}+\frac{\partial u_3}{\partial x_3}\right)^2 dx_1dx_2dx_3=0$

methods.what: Identity relating sum of squared gradients to squared curl plus divergence terms (cross terms)
methods.quote: $\Delta(u)$ $-2\frac{\partial u_1}{\partial x_2}\frac{\partial u_2}{\partial x_1}+2\frac{\partial u_1}{\partial x_1}\frac{\partial u_2}{\partial x_2}$
